concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-classic-platforms-verification-process-document-requirements]] — 2021-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Classic failed-verification document guide for individual ID, organization registration and bank evidence, with category-specific screenshot, age, page and size limits.
warnings: Individual photo-ID screenshots are rejected (raw lines 57–61), while online-banking screenshots are listed as bank-account evidence (raw line 107); keep categories distinct.
Bank-evidence age exceptions at raw lines 125–127 are not restated in the general older-than-12-month rejection at raw line 137.
The 15-page individual document statement at raw line 64 coexists with a two-page PDF limit at raw line 76.
